name: Groww

SDE-1.dsaDepth: Moderate - 2 to 3 DSA rounds, an assignment round appears in some loops
rounds: Referral or application, then an HR call
Assignment round (take-home, about 24 hrs) in some loops
Technical round(s): 1–3 DSA problems, one hour each
HR round: basic profile and expectations

SDE-2.dsaDepth: Heavy - DSA plus machine coding and system/HLD design
rounds: Round 1: 1–2 DSA problems (medium–hard: linked list, tree, graph)
Round 2: machine coding (e.g. an expense-sharing app like Splitwise, full class design and APIs)
extraTopics: Machine coding with clean, extensible OOP
JavaScript/React or Android depth for frontend/mobile roles
SDE-2.notes: Reports show anywhere from 2 to 5 rounds depending on team and channel (referral vs off-campus).
